title: No Fixed Address — semantic visual catalogue and depiction plan
status: Production planning only; no artwork generated or manuscript changed by this catalogue.

style.presentation: Circular repair-sticker tokens; transparent outside the circular rim; no rectangular page icon backgrounds outside that rim.
style.palette: Deep inky navy/aubergine, warm cream, cyan and amber; Moth orange; restrained vermilion for genuine stop/fault parts.
style.mark_making: Strong silhouette, broad cut ink masses, deliberately sparse screenprint/risograph grain; visible wear must survive reduction.
style.scene_relationship: All art is representative iconic notation. Larger equipment and facade tokens are ordinary draggable system states. Only migration-monitor is fixed, still a circular iconic display; no literal scene registration or assembly overlays.
style.text: Use only essential broad diegetic labels where helpful (ASK ME, 8B, sign directions); never rely on miniature body text, serials or verdict stamps. In-game names/readings identify semantic state.
style.reuse: Items assigned to the same drawing_id should reference exactly the same runtime file. Do not generate visually near-identical siblings for invisible tests, permissions, configuration, identity or evidence conclusions.

entries.critical_visible_distinctions: Receiver and battery are physically present; Miro’s original pocket player is absent, as narrated.
entries.exact_image_sharing_rationale: Tuning and receiving music do not change the connected hardware. Exact reuse avoids an extra decorative music-state icon.

entries.name: Breakfast for the night shift
entries.description: Sal finishes the noodles in the broth and fills the waiting bowls. Eli arrives with an empty delivery cart. Ren has handed over the pump shift, and there is a place for everyone who is awake enough to eat.
entries.physical_depiction: One generous cream bowl of noodles in warm amber broth with chopsticks and restrained steam, a representative serving for the shared night-shift breakfast.
entries.critical_visible_distinctions: A served bowl made from the earlier broth/noodles, with no luxury additions or implied optional music; one representative portion does not imply breakfast is limited to one person.
entries.exact_image_sharing_rationale: One drawing for this physical form; a token is representative, not a literal scene installation.

continuity_rules: Moth is one chipped orange terminal with one stubby antenna, one ASK ME sticker and the same monochrome screen, never a brain, humanoid or newly duplicated terminal. Repaired fan and off switch persist into dawn.

June’s four-caster U-handle trolley remains separately available after clinic-delivery. That result uses the sealed crate alone. Only dawn cart states combine the actual trolley and insulated carrier.

The clinic cooler has two separate air-service bays. Empty, filter-only, fan-only and complete states each have their own drawing; all later states retain both parts and the independent logger once installed.
Miro’s wide orange-grey two-antenna controller differs from Moth; workshop adapter is replaced by its actual carried battery, and the demonstration latch stays on the bench.

The request tablet keeps its disconnected microphone, actual large button and actual cardboard hood through every assembly order. The complete request desk adds the printer and pencil, never a second Moth.
The rack’s leased approval path and outside data uplink are distinct. Removing one never removes the other prematurely; local selector and tactile labels persist.

Every rooftop radio state represents two endpoints. Independent operation requires two protected reserves and removed wall adapters. Solar states have two charging sets and no active charging at night; final tested core icons omit optional solar perimeter without denying its presence.

Pump controls retain the local relay, tested flow sensor and direct physical stop. A report is not proof of flow; late operational/test conclusions share neutral hardware artwork and rely on actual recipe/time context.
The neighbor gateway retains disconnected control outputs. The repeater bypass and the added local fault bell remain visible when fitted.
The repaired wicket keeps its latch reader, mechanical override and added two-way arrow. Only the dawn-open state opens the leaf.
Workshop shutter, paint and local display are independent physical changes. All eight combinations are drawn rather than silently showing an unfinished feature as complete.
Only migration-monitor is fixed: a stable circular iconic read-only display, no registered furniture/scenery placement, no transparent scenery replacement and no compound overlays.
review_plan: Use clean mechanically extracted pilot-v2 icons as palette/line/grain anchors, never the raw atlas with yellow fringe, after the production lead’s current fresh repair review. Its fifteen retained mappings are in b01; cell 15 is explicitly unselected padding; they are candidates, not an assertion that all are approved.

For each batch, provide its physical descriptions and critical distinctions plus the approved prior appearances of every recurring device. Generate the full family together when alternatives differ physically.

Inspect every crop at the existing 64px play size on warm navy, cream and actual background grounds. Check clipped parts, distinct silhouettes, grain, rim, handsets versus Moth and essential changes at this size.
Use fresh recognition review for the map as a flat record, open Moth, incomplete cooler bays, unknown door record and sensor test rig; exact evidence conclusions are not blind-image targets.
Inspect carrier/trolley/bike compatibility, request-tablet part retention, two radio endpoints, rack leads, pump stop and all facade combinations as informed continuity checks.
Same drawing_id means the exact same runtime asset URL, not regenerated siblings. Keep separate runtime identities and names; this catalogue changes no story semantics.

Retain selected master sheets, exact generation requests and selected runtime files through the main production workflow. Temporary review packets/crops remain under runs; this catalogue is the durable plan, not a review transcript.
